description: Live publisher/common flags that change runtime behavior. Treat like code — defaults in Java are not production truth until verified.
requiredWhen: Answer claims what happens in production / for publishers
Behavior is gated by PublisherConfigProxy / CommonConfigProvider / feature flags
Question involves enablement, caps, thresholds, lookback, similar articles, citations, or fail-fast

tool.name: multi-sql-mcp
tool.notes: Prefer MCP tools sql_execute_query when available; else CLI: multi-sql-mcp test query <connection> "<SQL>" --database <db>

stores.notes: Per-publisher overrides. Missing row → use code/common default from the Proxy call site.
stores.exampleSql: SELECT attribute, value, COUNT(*) AS pubs FROM trc.publisher_config WHERE attribute IN ({attrs}) GROUP BY attribute, value ORDER BY attribute, value

stores.notes: Global/service settings. Column is `name` (not attribute). Filter by service when multiple rows exist (e.g. kfc-search-engine-qna).
stores.exampleSql: SELECT name, setting, default_val, env, service, performer, update_time FROM common.config WHERE name IN ({attrs}) ORDER BY name, service

search-engine-qna:similar-articles-enabl.affects: Whether QuestionGenerationPipeline fetches similar articles for LLM context

search-engine-qna:fail-on-no-articles:en.affects: Per-pub override for failing generation when no similar articles

search-engine-qna:fail-on-no-articles:de.affects: Global default for fail-on-empty similar articles (prod may differ from code fallback)

search-engine:cap-limit-questions.affects: Cap on similar articles passed into question generation

search-engin:lookback-hours.notes: Typo key used by QnA configs facade; often passed as Vespa requestLimit
search-engin:lookback-hours.affects: QnA pipeline Vespa limit / lookback plumbing

should-send-videos-to-search-engine.affects: Whether pub content enters search-engine QnA path

trc:product-type-resolver:deeper-dive.affects: DeeperDive product enablement (verify value semantics in code)

queryRules: Prefer equality on indexed `attribute` / `name` — never LIKE '%x%' on publisher_config (huge table)
Distinguish code default vs common.config setting vs publisher_config override
If DB unreachable (VPN/creds), say so explicitly — do not invent live values
Record configLookups in the answer payload even when result is empty (proves you checked)
